hooks.command: D="${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/dash0-agent-plugin/codex"; S="$PLUGIN_ROOT/codex/codex-on-event.sh"; if [ -r "$S" ]; then "$S"; else mkdir -p "$D" 2>/dev/null; L="$D/incidents.log"; if [ ! -s "$L" ] || [ "$(wc -c <"$L" | tr -d " ")" -lt 65536 ]; then printf "%s\thook_script_missing\tcodex\t%s\t%s\n" "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$S" "${CODEX_THREAD_ID:-}" >>"$L" 2>/dev/null; fi; fi; exit 0
